_comment: Row 229. subject: Row 229 -- the SPA root gate builds current Vite inputs into attempt-owned output, reconciles a nonzero population of emitted executable/style references, and proves Flask serves those exact bytes at /assets instead of trusting source literals or a pre-existing frontend/dist

M2 row defect, source-evasive: a computed spread overrides the one surviving literal root assignment only at runtime, so the row-202 scan remains green but the current build emits /app/assets

M3 recreated fail-open: accept any nested URL containing /assets/, including /app/assets/, instead of requiring Flask's root /assets mount; the built adversarial fixture must fail its expected refusal
